title: IBM reports preliminary Q2 revenue of $17.2B, below $17.9B est., as CEO Arvind Krishna says customers are shifting spending to chips; IBM falls 20% pre-market (Amy Thomson/Bloomberg)
summary: Amy Thomson / Bloomberg: IBM reports preliminary Q2 revenue of $17.2B, below $17.9B est., as CEO Arvind Krishna says customers are shifting spending to chips; IBM falls 20% pre-market — International Business Machines Corp. shares slid after the company reported preliminary second-quarter sales that fell short of expectations …
